function_v0.doc:
Pull `amount` of the vault's underlying asset (USDC, 7 decimals)
out of the Blend strategy and send it to `to`.

Caller must be OWNER.  The strategy's `from.require_auth()` is
satisfied by an invoker-contract auth entry made by this contract
(the vault itself), exactly like the vault's own
`unwind_from_strategy` path.
function_v0.name: drain

udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Minimal mirror of the strategy's error type.  Only the `Ok` shape matters\non the success path; on error the transaction aborts anyway.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: StrategyError
